about_the_game:
Band together with your friends and conquer dungeons in Rebels of the Realm - a vibrant, low-poly co-op RPG packed with chaotic spells, heroic fails, and a dash of goofy charm.

Key Features:

  • Varied Player Classes: Choose from a diverse roster including Fighters, Mages, Rogues, and Paladins, each offering unique abilities and strategic gameplay options.

  • Swap Class Anytime: Unlike other games from this genre, you have the ability to swap and enhance any class whenever in town, so you won't be stuck with the first class you choose.

  • Dynamic Dungeons: Navigate through ever-changing dungeons filled with intimidating enemies. Test your competence in intense boss fights and strive to secure the most coveted gear.

  • Unique Co-op Mechanics: Experience our distinctive ragdoll physics that add a twist to player deaths. Fallen comrades can end up anywhere in the battle arena, but can be revived, so take note of the position of their body.

  • Rich Fantasy Setting: Explore an enchanting, low-poly world reminiscent of classic RPGs.

  • Progression and Power: Enhance your character's abilities as you gain powerful gear and face increasingly tough challenges designed to test your skills and teamwork.

  • Light-hearted Adventure: Delight in a game that doesn’t take itself too seriously, but offers serious fun. Enjoy a blend of humor and heroics that keeps the mood upbeat and the laughs coming.

Join the rebellion in Rebels of the Realm - where the fate of the world is a group effort, and every battle is a chance to be heroic in the most unexpectedly fun ways!
